subject: Post-call: Cost alignment & finance approver for BrightCart pilot
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lowe <sara@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: Cost alignment & finance approver for BrightCart pilot

Hi Sara — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and three asks so we stay tight on procurement and budget: 

Recap (2/20 discovery):
- Pilot scope: 2 internal apps (search assist + support triage) for a 6-week trial.
- Expected traffic: 600–900k tokens/day (peaks on weekdays), estimated 20–27M tokens/month.
- Success criteria: end-to-end latency < 350ms median for 1k token responses and cost target <= $X/1M tokens (you suggested a target range during the call).

Three asks + immediate next steps:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and the person who signs pricing or PO? (Name + role + email)
2) Who on your finance/procurement team will need the quote and vendor info? Any procurement portal or PO template we should use?
3) Give us a ballpark target $/1M tokens you want us to aim for for the pilot (you mentioned conservative vs stretch numbers; we can model both).

I attached a very rough token estimate CSV and a draft SOW (skeleton) to help your finance/procurement team run quick math. If it helps, we can produce a 1-page vendor summary for procurement with SOC2/KMS and DPA highlights.

Proposed next steps:
- You reply with buyer + finance contact (inline) by EOD Tue 2/22
- We send a 1-page procurement packet + preliminary quote by Wed 2/23
- Aim to have PO in-hand or signed SOW by the end of week of 3/1 if timelines align

Thanks — I’ll hold a shared calendar slot for a 20-min finance intro if you want us to meet together.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Attachments: rough-token-estimate.csv (CSV), BrightCart_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf (draft)
From: Sara Lowe <sara@brightcart.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightcart.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T18:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cost alignment & finance approver for BrightCart pilot

Thanks Mina — appreciate the clear notes. Quick answers inline: 

1) Economic buyer / signer: Tom Ellis (CFO) — tom.ellis@brightcart.com — will sign POs up to $100k; anything above that requires CEO approval.
2) Finance/procurement contact: Angie Park (AP email is procurement@brightcart.com); we also have a vendor portal (vendor.brightcart.com) where we upload W9/contract.
3) Target $/1M tokens: for the pilot our internal benchmark target is $750–$950 per 1M tokens. If you can show $650 in a stretch scenario we’d be very motivated.

Looping Tom explicitly — Tom, Mina and her team are proposing a 6-week pilot. They’ll send a compact procurement packet and an initial quote.

Sara
Sara Lowe
Head of Product, BrightCart
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightcart.com>, Sara Lowe <sara@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-21T09:06:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cost alignment & finance approver for BrightCart pilot

Tom — thanks for joining the thread. Per Sara’s note, we’ll model three price points for the pilot and show per-1M token economics and expected total cost for the 6-week run: 
- Conservative: $950 / 1M tokens
- Target: $750 / 1M tokens
- Stretch: $650 / 1M tokens (requires a 6-week usage commit + minor implementation guardrails)

Two quick clarifying items for finance so we can format the packet correctly: 
A) Would BrightCart prefer a vendor quote (PDF) or an SOW + PO flow? We can do both; our standard pilot quote includes: unit price / estimated tokens / estimated total / billing cadence (monthly).
B) Compliance pack: do you need SOC 2 report + DPA + info about KMS/HSM? We can attach our security one-pager and a short checklist for your procurement portal.

I’ve attached a short vendor-summary PDF (procurement friendly) and the rough token estimate so you can poke holes on the numbers. If you prefer, we can put together a two-line commitment for the stretch price (e.g., minimal weekly usage threshold to unlock $650).

If it helps, Marissa (cc’d) can prepare a vendor packet tailored to your vendor portal. What’s the best email to deliver that to? procurement@brightcart.com?

Best,
Mina
Attachments: BrightCart_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf, rough-token-estimate.csv
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightcart.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Lowe <sara@brightcart.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-21T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cost alignment & finance approver for BrightCart pilot

Thanks Mina. A few finance/procurement items up front: 
- We prefer SOW + PO for pilots under $100k. Please provide a one-page vendor summary with tax/VAT details, redwood.ai EIN, and a primary contact for invoice submission.
- Vendor portal: procurement@brightcart.com is the right target. We’ll need W9/CIC (for US entity) and the SOC2 attestation summary.
- Timeline: procurement team will review docs within 3 business days once uploaded. Typical internal approval for a pilot at our size is 5–7 business days after documentation is complete.

On pricing: the $750 target is reasonable for a pilot; $650 would require a firm usage commit and a short-term reserved capacity agreement. If you can put language in the SOW that describes the commit and the unlock condition (e.g., average weekly usage >= X tokens for the 6-week period) we can escalate to CEO for sign-off.

Please send the vendor packet to procurement@brightcart.com and cc me. Also include an invoice remit name/address and PO template fields (if you have sample PO language we can pre-fill).

Tom
Tom Ellis
CFO, BrightCart
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightcart.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sara Lowe <sara@brightcart.com>
Date: 2027-02-22T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cost alignment & finance approver for BrightCart pilot

Tom — thanks for the clear checklist. Hi all — we uploaded the procurement packet to the Drive link below and attached a compact vendor one-pager and a sample SOW that includes the two-tier pricing (conservative / stretch) and the unlock condition language for the $650 tier.

What we uploaded:
- Vendor one-pager (tax/EIN/remit info + SOC2 pointer)
- Sample SOW with pricing table and weekly usage unlock clause
- W9 copy + invoice remit fields
- rough-token-estimate.csv (detailed breakdown by endpoint / expected tokens)

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/brightcart-pilot-plan
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/BRG-4782

We’ll also prepare a pre-filled PO template (fillable PDF) that you can drop into your vendor portal to speed review. If finance wants a short walkthrough of the unlock mechanics, we can schedule a 20-min call tomorrow.

Marissa Cole
Director, GTM Solutions — Redwood Inference
Attachments: BrightCart_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf, vendor-onepager.pdf, W9_redwood.pdf
